### Create Email Campaign

URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/emails/locations/{locationId}/campaigns/emails
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/create-email-campaign | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/create-email-campaign.md

Create a new email campaign

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: emails/campaigns.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateEmailCampaignPublicV2BodyDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Untitled campaign name") - Campaign name
- editorType* string (enum: html | text; e.g. "html") - Editor type for the campaign content. Use `html` for code-editor campaigns or `text` for plain-text campaigns.
- templateId string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Existing template ID to create the campaign from. Omit this field to create a blank campaign.
- editorContent string (e.g. "<html><body>Hello World</body></html>") - Optional initial editor content to persist immediately after campaign creation. Provide HTML or plain-text string content.
- parentFolderId string (e.g. "67f15c2ae99226d5bcccb8f0") - Parent folder ID
- timeZone* string (e.g. "Asia/Kolkata") - Timezone for the campaign
- userId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439099") - ID of the user performing this action
- userName string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the user performing this action

Response 201 (Success) application/json:
- id* string - Campaign ID
- source string - Source of the campaign
- sourceId string - Source ID of the campaign
- name string - Campaign name
- status string (enum: all | sent | failed | archived | draft | processing | scheduled | cancelled | paused) - Campaign status
- campaignType string - Campaign type
- campaignCategory string - Campaign category
- variations object[] - AB test variation identifiers (available only for AB test campaigns)
  - sourceId* string - Variation source ID for stats lookup
  - isWinner* boolean - Whether this is the winning variation
- deleted* boolean - Whether the campaign is deleted
- createdAt* string - Created at timestamp
- updatedAt* string - Last updated timestamp
- traceId string - Trace ID of request

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier

- sortBy string (enum: updatedAt; default: updatedAt) - Field to sort by
- sortOrder string (enum: asc | desc; default: desc) - Sort direction
- archived boolean (default: false) - Return archived templates
- folderId string (e.g. "root") - Folder to list templates from. Use 'root' for top-level listing.
- include string (enum: all | templates | folders; default: all) - Whether to include templates, folders, or both in the response. `templates` will return only templates, `folders` will return only folders, and `all` will return both.

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- items* object[] - List of template and folder resources
  - id* string - Resource ID
  - name* string - Resource name
  - type* string (enum: template | folder) - Resource type
  - isPlainText boolean - Whether template is plain text
  - updatedAt string - Last updated timestamp
  - createdAt string - Created timestamp
  - previewUrl string - Preview URL
  - editorType string (enum: html | builder | text) - Editor type for template resources
  - childCount number - Children count for folder resources
  - hasChildren boolean - Whether folder has child resources
  - parentFolderId string - Parent folder ID
- total* number - Total count of templates and folders
- traceId string - Trace ID of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier

### Schedule Campaign
POST /emails/locations/{locationId}/campaigns/emails/{campaignId}/schedule
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/emails/locations/{locationId}/campaigns/emails/{campaignId}/schedule
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/schedule-campaign | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/schedule-campaign.md

Schedule or start an email campaign. The campaign must be in draft, cancelled, or paused status.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: emails/campaigns.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID
- campaignId* string (e.g. "67f15c2ae99226d5bcccb8f3") - Campaign ID

Request body (required) (application/json) ScheduleCampaignPublicV2BodyDto:
- scheduleType* string (enum: immediate | scheduled | batch | rss | smart_send; e.g. "immediate") - How to schedule the campaign
- timeZone* string (e.g. "America/New_York") - IANA timezone
- userId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439099") - ID of the user performing this action
- userName string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the user performing this action
- emailMeta* object - Email subject, sender, and content metadata
  - subject* string (e.g. "Our February Newsletter") - Email subject line
  - fromName* string (e.g. "John Doe") - Sender display name
  - fromEmail* string (e.g. "john@example.com") - Sender email address
  - replyToAddress string (e.g. "reply@example.com") - Reply-to email address
  - previewText string (e.g. "Check out our latest news") - Preview text shown in inbox after subject
  - attachments string[] (e.g. ["https://example.com/file.pdf"]) - Attachment download URLs
- recipients* object - Who receives the email. Must provide either contactIds or filter.
  - type* string (enum: contact | tag | segment; e.g. "contact") - Recipient selection type
  - contactIds string[] (e.g. ["contactId1","contactId2"]) - Contact IDs to send to. Required when type is contact.
  - tagIds string[] (e.g. ["tagId1","tagId2"]) - Tag IDs to filter recipients by. Required when type is tag.
  - segment string (enum: engaged_last_7_days | engaged_last_30_days | engaged_last_60_days | engaged_last_5_campaigns | unengaged_last_5_campaigns; e.g. "engaged_last_7_days") - Segment type for pre-built segments. Required when type is segment.
  - freezeList boolean (default: true) - Freeze the contact list at schedule time — new matching contacts will not be added later
- sendDays string[] (enum: Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun; e.g. ["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"]) - Days of the week to allow sending. Used for batch and RSS scheduleTypes.
- scheduleConfig object - Schedule configuration for immediate, scheduled, batch, and smart_send types. Required when scheduleType is not rss.
  - sendAt string (e.g. "2026-04-01 09:00 AM") - Date/time to send. Required for scheduled, batch, and smart_send. Ignored for immediate.
  - batch object - Batch/drip configuration. Required when scheduleType is batch. Ignored otherwise.
    - batchSize* number (e.g. 100) - Number of contacts to process per batch
    - interval* number (e.g. 2) - Delay between batches
    - intervalUnit* string (enum: minutes | hours | days; e.g. "hours") - Unit for the interval
    - skipDays string[] (enum: Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun; e.g. ["Sat","Sun"]) - Days to skip sending
    - windowStart string (e.g. "09:00 AM") - Earliest time to send batches
    - windowEnd string (e.g. "05:00 PM") - Latest time to send batches
  - tracking object - Click and UTM tracking options
    - clickTracking boolean - Enable click tracking on links
    - utmTracking boolean - Enable UTM parameters on links
  - resend object - Auto-resend to contacts who did not open
    - enabled boolean - Enable resend to contacts who did not open
    - waitHours number (e.g. 12) - Hours to wait before resending. Required when enabled is true.
    - subject string (e.g. "Did you miss this?") - Override subject line for the resend email
  - emailPreferenceId string (e.g. "preference-type-id") - Email preference type ID for categorizing this campaign
- rssConfig object - RSS feed configuration. Required when scheduleType is rss.
  - name* string (e.g. "Weekly Digest") - RSS schedule name
  - rssFeedURL* string (e.g. "https://example.com/rss") - RSS feed URL
  - repeatAfter* string (enum: every_day | every_week | every_month; e.g. "every_day") - How often to check the feed
  - repeatAfterTime* string (e.g. "09:00 AM") - Time of day to execute
  - rssFeedLimit number (e.g. 10) - Max number of RSS items per email
  - startAtDay string (enum: Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday; e.g. "Monday") - Day of week for weekly RSS
  - startAtMonthDay string (e.g. "15") - Day of month for monthly RSS
  - firstExecutionDate string (e.g. "2026-04-01 10:00:00") - Override first execution date/time
- abTestConfig object - A/B test configuration. Can be combined with any scheduleType except rss.
  - testType* string (enum: emailContent | subjectLine; e.g. "subjectLine") - What is being tested
  - testDuration* number (e.g. 3600) - Seconds to run the test before picking a winner
  - variationCount* number (e.g. 2) - Number of variations
  - testSize* number (e.g. 30) - Percentage of contacts in the test group (0-100)
  - winningCriteria* string (enum: openRate | clickRate; e.g. "openRate") - How to pick the winner
  - variations* object[] - A/B test variations
    - subject string (e.g. "Subject A") - Subject line for this variation
    - documentId string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Template/document ID for this variation

Response 201 (Success) application/json:
- campaignId* string - Campaign ID
- sourceId* string (nullable) - Source ID for fetching campaign statistics
- traceId string - Trace ID of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier
Response 409 (Conflict - Campaign is already scheduled or being processed): no body
